title: Capital One to Copa Airlines ConnectMiles 30% Transfer Bonus Through Dec 1, 2026
summary: Capital One is offering a 30% transfer bonus to Copa Airlines ConnectMiles through Dec 1, 2026
body_markdown:
Capital One is offering a 30% transfer bonus to Copa Airlines ConnectMiles through Dec 1, 2026. Confirm it in the


[official transfer portal](https://travel-on-points.com/current-point-transfer-bonuses/) before you move anything, because transfers only go one way.


## How the bonus works


Capital One points transfer to Copa Airlines ConnectMiles at 2:1.5. With the 30% bonus, 1,000 points become


**975 miles**


through Dec 1, 2026.


Transfers are not always instant, so leave time for the points to land before you count on a specific seat.


## Roame's take


Useful for a confirmed Copa or Star Alliance award; compare award availability, taxes, and surcharges before transferring.


## Before you transfer


Price the award and confirm the space first, then transfer only what that booking needs. Every live offer is listed in the


[current transfer bonus tracker](https://roame.travel/guides/points-transfer-bonuses) .
